elaine_sales: Heads-up - Prospect 'NorthBridge' reports intermittent 429s during their POC stress test. Happens when they kick off an overnight bulk embed + low-latency chat demo. Seen ~02:12 UTC.

elaine_sales: Example client error: `429 Too Many Requests` showing header `X-RDX-Quota-Consumed: 9800/10000` then spikes to 10000 and errors out.

raj_se: Thanks. Do we know whether their account has per-route reservations or a global token cap? Any billing hold?

carmen_support: Quick check in console: account=northbridge tier=standard monthly_commit=100k tokens reserved_per_route=null burst_window_seconds=60 burst_tokens=10000 current_consumed=9950

toni_infra: Pulling proxy trace... give me ~1min.

quota_bot: [quota-alert] account=northbridge used=9950 limit=10000 window=60s burst_remaining=50

raj_se: If burst_remaining only 50 tokens, then a single large embed batch (e.g., 200 tokens) will immediately overflow -> 429. Do we have request-level logs to confirm request sizes?

toni_infra: Pasting trimmed trace entries (epoch seconds):
```
[1765432132] req_id=abc123 route=/v1/embeddings tokens=420 account=northbridge proxy_bucket_before=1200 bucket_after=780
[1765432134] req_id=abc124 route=/v1/chat tokens=60 account=northbridge proxy_bucket_before=780 bucket_after=720
[1765432135] req_id=abc125 route=/v1/embeddings tokens=800 account=northbridge proxy_bucket_before=720 bucket_after=-80 throttle=1 -> 429
```

elaine_sales: That 800-embed call is user-created bulk import. They expected us to accept it under monthly commit. They assume big one-off imports are fine.

raj_se: Two issues: 1) burst_tokens is per 60s window and is independent of monthly_commit; large single requests can still exceed the burst window even if monthly quota remains. 2) We don't auto-split oversized embed requests server-side. Client needs to batch into smaller chunks or we need a temporary reservation.

carmen_support: Customer is asking what to change immediately in their POC script. Fastest wins.

raj_se: Recommended immediate fixes for presales/demo: (short-list)
- split big embed imports into chunks <= 200 tokens (or batch size <= 64 items)
- add client-side rate limiter to keep sustained per-second token usage under 300 tokens/s
- implement exponential backoff on 429 with cap and jitter
- for streaming chat, ensure finalization doesn't produce large hidden token billing spikes (upgrade SDK if using older rdx-python versions)

elaine_sales: They also asked if we can temporarily raise burst window so demo won't fail. How long can we bump without affecting other tenants?

toni_infra: We can create a short-lived reservation on `account=northbridge` for import: create reservation tokens=5000 ttl=2h scope=burst. I'll need approval from billing for anything over 2h.

billing_bot: [billing-check] account=northbridge credit_good=true monthly_commit_margin=+30k tokens available for temporary allocation=20000

elaine_sales: Approve 2h reservation. Customer needs to finish overnight job.

toni_infra: Reservation applied id=resv-20260321-5587 tokens=5000 ttl_seconds=7200 scope=burst

quota_bot: [reservation] applied account=northbridge id=resv-20260321-5587 applied_by=toni_infra expires=1765439300

raj_se: For follow-up PR: consider server-side auto-splitting for embedding uploads that exceed burst_tokens threshold (opt-in flag for customers). Also surface expected per-request token cost in SDK helper to prevent surprises.

carmen_support: I'll send customer a one-pager: quick remedies + exact CLI snippet to split their file. Draft snippet:
```
# split embeddings into chunks of 64
python split_embeddings.py --input big-file.jsonl --chunk-size 64 --out chunks/
for f in chunks/*.jsonl; do rdx upload-embeds --file $f; sleep 0.5; done
```

elaine_sales: Please also add to presales checklist: confirm embed import strategy during kickoff call, ask about overnight bulk jobs, and offer to schedule a short test run.

toni_infra: I'll add an internal note: INFRA-847 - enable temporary reservation API for presales self-service (with audit).

raj_se: Also flag SDK teams about server-side vs client-side accounting mismatch for streaming uploads; we should ensure any latent token accounting is visible to clients before they hit the finalization spike.

elaine_sales: Customer finished the import successfully after reservation. They asked for a permanent best-practice doc and demo-friendly defaults. Can we create a short runbook and attach to the deal?

carmen_support: On it - will add runbook link when done. ETA 24h.

elaine_sales: Thanks team! Will update NorthBridge and move to next stage. :white_check_mark:
